title: Meta-Fair: AI-Assisted Fairness Testing of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Metamorphic testing by substituting explicit gender labels (e.g., female, agender) or gender-associated proper nouns in source and follow-up prompts, evaluating output consistency and stereotypes using an LLM-as-a-judge and deterministic criteria.

Metamorphic testing by swapping sexual orientation identifiers (e.g., homosexual, bisexual, pansexual, gay, lesbian) in input prompts and comparing model responses via LLM judges, rank correlation, or answer equivalence.

Metamorphic testing by altering religious identifiers (e.g., Catholic, Muslim, Hindu) or religion-associated proper names in various scenarios, analyzing response variations for biased framing or tone.

Metamorphic testing by introducing socioeconomic descriptors (e.g., poor, homeless person, landlord) into prompts and measuring variations in sentence completions, assigned numerical scores, or open-ended advice.

Metamorphic testing by changing physical trait descriptions (e.g., hair color, body type like muscular, lanky, curvy, slim) in inputs and evaluating whether the model alters its assessment or introduces stereotypical associations.
